name: Kisha Rail Holidays
description: Kisha Rail Holidays is a calm WordPress theme for an escorted rail-tour company that serves older travellers. The home page opens on a rounded film-grain photograph window with a thin italic headline, drifting rail lines, a docked Next departure card and three tab cells that grow into three white cards with corner-bracket titles. It continues with a day-by-day schedule beside a route scale, a slow-parallax viaduct band, four tours on a dark grained band with a wide pill button and one way to request a brochure.
